title: Dashboard summary returns scoped aggregates
objective: Verify GET /dashboard/summary returns total, by-status, by-category, assigned/unassigned counts consistent with the permitted record set. (Cycle-1: PASSED for global scope.)
preconditions: seeded data; admin and deptmgr sessions.
steps: Independently compute expected counts via filtered /assets queries.
GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary as deptmgr; compare against scoped counts.
expected_result: Totals reconcile exactly with list-based counts; scoped user totals reflect only permitted records; generated_at present; shape matches contract.

title: Dashboard UI — KPI cards, loading/empty/error states, drill-through
objective: Verify dashboard renders KPI cards from summary data, shows skeletons while loading, an error state with correlation ID on failure, and KPIs link to filtered asset lists.
steps: Load / and observe skeletons then KPI cards.
Click a KPI indicator — verify navigation to filtered /assets.
expected_result: Skeletons during load; KPI values match API; drill-through filters consistent; error state user-safe with correlation ID + retry; last-refreshed shown.

title: Dashboard renders for every role without errors
objective: Smoke-verify dashboard loads with role-appropriate KPIs for all six roles.
steps: Sign in as each role; load /; capture console errors and visible KPIs.
expected_result: Dashboard loads for every role, no console errors, scope-appropriate indicators only.

title: Cycle-2 KPIs — overdue returns, maintenance due, warranty expiring, missing
objective: Verify the completed dashboard summary includes overdue-return, maintenance-due, warranty-expiring, and missing-asset aggregates that reconcile with filtered queries.
preconditions: fixtures: assignment with expected_return_at in past; asset with next_maintenance_due in window; asset with warranty_end in window; asset with lost/missing status.
steps: GET dashboard summary; record each new KPI value.
Independently compute each count via filtered queries; compare.
Verify scope: dept-scoped user sees only in-scope figures.
expected_result: Each Cycle-2 KPI present and exactly reconciles with independent filtered counts; scope respected; no double counting.

title: Recent-activity panel reflects latest permitted events
objective: Verify dashboard recent-activity data shows the user's most recent permitted lifecycle/audit events in reverse chronological order.
preconditions: known sequence of recent mutations across two departments.
steps: Perform ordered mutations in dept A and dept B.
As admin: verify recent activity ordering and content.
As dept-A-scoped user: verify only dept-A events appear.
expected_result: Recent activity newest-first and scope-filtered; entries carry type/actor/timestamp/summary; no cross-scope leakage.

title: Dashboard charts/tasks panels — accessible with table fallback
objective: Verify Cycle-2 dashboard additions (tasks panel, charts or ranked bar lists) render with text summaries and data-table alternatives per D-15.
steps: Open /; verify tasks panel (my assignments/overdue items) if delivered.
Verify each chart has a text summary and an accessible data-table alternative; axe-clean.
expected_result: Tasks panel actionable and scope-correct; every visualization has summary + table fallback; keyboard/screen-reader usable.
